key_facts: Expediente 121/000096 is the Proyecto de Ley Orgánica para el buen uso y la gobernanza de la inteligencia artificial (LOIA), Spain's national law implementing the EU AI Act (Reg. (UE) 2024/1689).
Approved by the Council of Ministers on 26 May 2026; presented to the Congreso on 28 May 2026; qualified (calificado) on 8 June 2026; published in BOCG-Congreso Serie A núm. 97-1 on 12 June 2026.
Assigned to the Comisión de Economía, Comercio y Transformación Digital; processed under the ordinary (non-urgency) procedure.

OFFICIAL STATUS (Congreso amendment-deadline table updated 17 July 2026): expediente 121/000096 shows only two 'Todo o Totalidad' dates — 30-06-2026 and 02-09-2026 (bold, operative). The 'Articulado' column is empty.
The bill remains in the amendment-to-the-entirety phase; the original 30 June 2026 deadline was extended to 2 September 2026 at 18:00 (standard summer-recess resumption date).

No enmienda a la totalidad (motion to return the bill to the Government) is recorded as filed, debated or approved as of mid-July 2026; no debate de totalidad, ponencia or committee vote has occurred.
As an organic law, final passage will require an absolute majority in Congress; the bill is not yet applicable law.
AESIA (headquartered in A Coruña) is the default supervisory authority; sectoral authorities include AEPD, CGPJ, Banco de España, CNMV and DGSFP.
Sanctions reproduce EU AI Act Art. 99: up to €35M/7% turnover (very serious), €7.5M/1% (serious), €500,000/0.5% (minor); SMEs/startups fined on the lower figure.
EU AI Act high-risk (Annex III) and Art. 50 transparency obligations applied from 2 August 2026 regardless of the Spanish law; the EU Digital Omnibus delay proposal failed at April 2026 trilogue.
